The '''Elgit system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elgit]] and [[the Pearl]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]].
